# Double-width cell-run golden fixture
# Unicode 15.0.0 — UAX #11 East Asian Width (W and F → 2 cells)
#
# Wide characters (EAW=W or F) occupy 2 terminal columns each.
# CJK ideographs, Hangul syllables, and fullwidth ASCII variants are wide.
#
# Format: description | utf8 bytes (hex) | tab_width → total_cells | spans
# Kind codes: T=text, C=combining, TAB=tab, CTL=control, INV=invalid_utf8

# U+4E2D '中' (CJK ideograph, EAW=W): E4 B8 AD (3 bytes)
cjk_zhong         | E4 B8 AD       | 4 → 2 | 0:3:2:T

# U+FF21 'Ａ' (Fullwidth Latin Capital A, EAW=F): EF BC A1 (3 bytes)
fullwidth_A       | EF BC A1       | 4 → 2 | 0:3:2:T

# U+AC00 '가' (Hangul syllable GA, EAW=W): EA B0 80 (3 bytes)
hangul_ga         | EA B0 80       | 4 → 2 | 0:3:2:T

# Two CJK ideographs: 中文 (zhōngwén)
# U+4E2D E4 B8 AD + U+6587 E6 96 87
two_cjk           | E4 B8 AD E6 96 87 | 4 → 4 | 0:3:2:T 3:3:2:T

# Mixed narrow + wide: "a中b"
# 'a' (61) + U+4E2D (E4 B8 AD) + 'b' (62)
mixed_narrow_wide | 61 E4 B8 AD 62 | 4 → 4 | 0:1:1:T 1:3:2:T 4:1:1:T

# U+3042 'あ' (Hiragana A, EAW=W): E3 81 82 (3 bytes)
hiragana_a        | E3 81 82       | 4 → 2 | 0:3:2:T

# U+FF01 '！' (Fullwidth Exclamation Mark, EAW=F): EF BC 81 (3 bytes)
fullwidth_bang     | EF BC 81      | 4 → 2 | 0:3:2:T
